submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole retrospectively detects results-reporting frames: text stating a recorded competitive outcome (tournament stage, placement, score, title, event edition) or an official measured specification (dimensions, mass, stats, record quantities) for a named subject, accumulating over a multi-sentence factual context. Casual mentions of the same words (liking tennis), bare quantities without a results frame (a temperature, a count of birds, a year alone), and same-subject non-result sentences stay flat.
